_help: One entry per release, newest first. 'version' must match package.json. Write for the people who use the app: plain words, what they will notice. The release workflow refuses to build a tag that has no entry here. Groups: new, improved, fixed (any of them may be empty).

releases.title: Scanner and pen in Signature Scanning, Wing and Office Master fixed
new: Signature Scanning window: a Scan button opens the Windows scanner dialog (installed app only). The scanned image is resized and saved as a signature of under 2 MB; if you cancel, nothing happens, and if it fails the message tells you what to do.

Signature Scanning window, drawing pad: you can now sign with a mouse, touch or a pen / graphics tablet. With a pen, a light touch draws a thin line and a firm press a thick one; a palm resting on the screen after the pen is ignored.
improved: Wing Master and Office Master windows: now save into the wing and office lists the rest of the app actually reads, so what you save shows up in Member Master and in searches.

Office Master window: Division / RO is now chosen from the wing list and shows the wing code; a "..." button next to it opens Wing Master. A new Division No box was added. Leave Branch No blank for a new branch and the server gives the next free number; a typed number that already exists is refused instead of overwriting. Moving an office to another wing moves its members too.
Wing Master window: the example code is now a plain number, and a wing that members or offices still use cannot be deleted.
fixed: System Update window and the update pop-up: the app read the server version from the wrong place in the server reply, so every update looked unverified and the install was blocked. It now reads it correctly (ES-682).
Server, Wing Master: the window saved into a table nothing reads; it now edits the real wing table, and State must be 1 or 0 (ES-326).

Server, Office Master: the window saved into a table nothing reads and a typed office number could overwrite an existing one; it now edits the real office table and refuses a number that exists (ES-299).

releases.title: Signature Scanning: legacy signatures and member search
new: Signature Scanning window: members whose signature was migrated from the old system now show that signature, so you can see it without scanning it again.
improved: Signature Scanning window: the member box now uses the same member search as Member Master. Press F2, the search button or double space to open the list, or type the member number and press Enter to load the member.
Signature Scanning window: the Delete button now asks you to confirm before it removes the saved signature of the member.
fixed: Signature Scanning window: the member number box is now filled in correctly after a member is picked or loaded.

releases.title: Member Master rules, one person one member, sky-blue look saved per person
new: Modify Business Rules window, new Members section: set the minimum age at joining (default 18) and the minimum and maximum for Compulsory Deposit and for Monthly Contribution. 0 means no limit, and the deposit ranges start switched off. The rules are checked when a member is saved in Member Master.
Member Master window: the Age box now shows the age on the membership date (today when there is none), and an empty Retirement Date is filled with the end of the month in which the member turns 60.
improved: Member Master window: Monthly Contribution and Member Type are now saved with the member, so the screen no longer shows 0 for them after a reload.

Member Master window: Branch MS No is its own free-text box again, and the Branch dropdown only sets the office number. The branch list is shared and an old branch text no longer shows in the wrong box.
Member Master window: the old no-date value 1900-01-01 now shows as an empty date, and a joining date before the birth date is refused.

Settings panel: the default accent colour is now sky blue. Each person's saved look (theme and colour) is loaded at every login, so after a logout and login the previous person's look no longer stays, and every change is saved to the server a moment after it is made.
Head Addition / Modification window: a head group with an unknown section letter now shows its letter instead of an empty name.
fixed: Server, Member Master: one Personal Number can belong to only one member. A duplicate on a new member or on an edit shows one clear message, and two saves at the same moment can no longer both succeed (ES-652).
Server, Member Master: new member numbers are given from one locked counter in the 990,000,000 to 999,999,999 block and skip numbers already held (ES-310).
Server, Member Master: a joining date before the birth date is refused and the old 1900-01-01 no-date value counts as empty (ES-382).
Server, Settings: the default accent colour is sky blue for people who never changed it (ES-668).

releases.title: Live users and analytics, one password rule, a clearer System Update window
new: Logout User window, Live users tab: every enabled user is one card, with a green dot while that person's app is still sending its minute heartbeat. People who are online come first, then the most recently seen. One click logs a person out, and their card goes quiet at once.
Logout User window, Analytics tab: sign-ins per day, the busiest hours, the average session length, the most active people and sessions that never closed, for the last 1 to 365 days.

System Update window redesigned: it shows the installed version, the time of the last check, the release notes of the available version grouped as New, Improved and Fixed, and a table of which backend versions each Frontend version works with. Updates are switched off in a development run.

Modify Business Rules, Loan Early Closure Protection card: a new switch decides whether Close on next month's outstanding may be used for a member who has unpaid (NR) instalments. It is ON by default.
improved: Loan Early Closure window: when the member has NR and Business Rules do not allow the next-month option, the option is greyed out up front, and clicking it opens a card that says why. If the server refuses an option, its own reason is shown instead of a generic red line.

Change Password window: a double click or Enter plus click now sends one request. Before, the second request met the already changed password and showed Current password is incorrect even though the change had worked.
Change Password and Create / Modify Users windows: both show and check the same password rule as the server, 8 to 64 characters with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter and a number.
Sign-in sessions now carry the Day-End working date and the real time of sign-out, so a session that crosses midnight no longer shows a negative length.
fixed: Server, Change Password: the current-password check and the save now run under one lock on the person's row, so ten requests sent at once can no longer all pass the check (ES-658).

Server, Change Password: wrong current passwords are counted per person like sign-in, and 5 wrong in 15 minutes lock the person for 15 minutes (ES-656). A new password may not be the current one or one of the last 5 (ES-207), and every other signed-in PC or stolen session stops working the moment the password changes (ES-297).
Server, sign-in and Change Password: login names now match in any letter case, as they already did for new names and in the old system, so test1212 and TEST1212 are one login (ES-659).

Server, passwords: a password such as $2b$Abcdef1 was mistaken for an already scrambled one and stored as plain text, so the person could never sign in. Only a real 60-character hash is kept as it is now, and a password may not start with $2a$, $2b$ or $2y$ (ES-654).
Server, passwords: nothing limited the length, and anything past 72 bytes was silently cut. The maximum is 64 characters (ES-657).

Server, passwords: Change Password, Forgot password and an administrator creating a user or resetting a password now follow one rule. Before, an administrator could hand out a 6-character password (ES-660).
Server, Create / Modify Users: a new person reusing the id of a deleted person no longer inherits that person's remembered passwords (ES-655).

Server, Loan Early Closure: the quote and the execution apply the same rule for the next-month option and the same awaited EMI. Any other unpaid due instalment is settled as NR, or the option is refused when Business Rules do not allow it.

releases.title: RD/CD interest decisions and window rights per person
new: RD/CD Interest window: for each member, see the interest worked out the way the society's printed RD chart is made, and choose Allow or Deny with a reason. Allow counts a late instalment as paid on time; Deny gives interest only from the month the money was deposited.
RD/CD Financial Year Closing closes the year for every member in one go, each posted with his saved decision. A Business Rules switch controls whether fully regular members are allowed automatically.
Create / Modify Users lets you set each person's own window rights. Once set, those are the person's rights; the level's defaults are only the starting point.
Head Addition / Modification and Head Opening Balance windows were rebuilt, with each head kept under its own section and a warning before typed numbers would be lost.
improved: Login names are checked as you type: no spaces, 1 to 20 characters, and only letters, digits, dot, underscore and hyphen.
Passbook Printing was reworked.
Dialogs now open above sticky table headers.

releases.title: Date settings, bulk Compulsory Deposit charge and loan penal rate exceptions
new: Date settings under Day End: for each window, choose whether entries are dated with the Day-End working date (the default) or the real date of the day. The date shown on a window is the one the server will use.
Compulsory Deposit (Legacy) window: charge many members' Compulsory Deposit in one go and credit a head.
Loan Sanction can set a different penal rate for one loan, with a reason. Without it, Business Rules apply.
Loan Sanction shows the largest loan allowed and any RD or Share shortfall as soon as you enter an amount.
improved: Searching for a member never picks someone from an older list than what is typed in the box, and clearing the box searches again.
Pasted amounts keep their decimal point, so 100.50 stays 100.50, and signs or exponents are refused.
The dashboard cards reload by themselves when the window comes back after a few minutes and every ten minutes while open.
Signing out is recorded, and the sign-in history in My Profile closes every open session.
Saving Bank menus are hidden while that feature is switched off.

releases.title: NR Repayment, a real My Profile and clearer dividend windows
new: Loan Repayment is now called NR Repayment (Not Recovered). It opens from the same place and keeps your rights.
My Profile shows your own details and your latest sign-ins, and says Not recorded for anything the system does not hold.
Dividend windows have financial-year dropdowns, a status column and a warning when a figure is only an estimate.
improved: Screens across Administration, Masters, Transactions, Reports and Utility now translate fully when you choose another language.
Saakh Score uses clean icons instead of emoji.
Early Closure and NR Repayment show more of what is owed and why.
fixed: Surety Register and Member Loan Detail load far faster, and each loan shows its own member's amounts.

releases.title: Early closure in Past Transaction, safer Import Demand List and a clearer Business Rules window
new: Loan Early Closure is now sent to Past Transaction and posted when it is passed. A new option closes the loan on next month's outstanding for regular payers, and the closure waits until that EMI arrives.
Import Demand List reads the payroll Excel/CSV file as it comes, with a choice of Strict (any problem and nothing is saved) or Standard (bad rows are skipped), and every row is kept in an import log.
Modify Business Rules is organised into tabs with a search box, marks the settings you have changed but not saved, and shows settings the application does not use yet as locked.
RD/CD Repayment shows the member's summary and lets you enter the 12 monthly instalments in one grid.
Loan Re-agreement tells you when only one EMI is left.
improved: Amount boxes accept only digits and up to two decimals, and typing in the demand grid is quick even with thousands of members.
Loan Repayment, Journal Transfer and Compulsory Deposit screens were refreshed.

releases.title: Society Calculator and rules profiles
new: Society Calculator under Utility: what-if calculations for loan EMI, closure and penalty. Nothing is saved.
Modify Business Rules can export the rules to a file and import them back; an import only fills the screen and shows what would change, and nothing is stored until you click Save Rules.
Mobile Control Center has new Features and Security Audit panels.
A loan approval card in My Profile.
Dashboard cards can each have their own picture, chosen in Customize mode.
improved: The Loan Position table folds its groups open and closed, with the loan summary and amount owed open first.
Dates are shown the same way on loan screens (05 Mar 2024) and never shift by a day.
Reports and certificate screens, the cash position card and the dashboard were refreshed.

releases.title: A customisable dashboard and delayed-payroll handling
new: Dashboard art: pick a background picture in Settings, Dashboard, from ten styles in Light and Dark, or import your own.
Customize mode on the dashboard: move, resize, switch cards off and add them back; Ctrl+N opens a new member.
Notice board with private sticky notes, colours and an important marker for administrators.
Early Closure now shows delayed payroll principal and interest separately, and lets you record that it was already returned to the member.
improved: Settings is organised into clearer sections, with Alert Channels and System & Window.
Early Closure tells you when the closure date falls inside the grace period of an unpaid instalment.
Each PC's log now carries its own name, so support can tell which PC an error came from.

releases.title: More languages, System Update and Mobile Control Center
new: More languages: Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Odia, Punjabi, Sanskrit, Tamil, Telugu, Urdu and Chhattisgarhi are now available in Settings, Language, alongside Hindi.
System Update screen under Utility: see the installed version and what is available.
Mobile Control Center for administrators: review member app activation requests, member access and phone quality in one place.
improved: Error messages now say in plain words what went wrong and what to do next, instead of showing technical text.
The screens you open most were refreshed for consistency.

releases.title: Guided start and Hindi
new: A welcome walkthrough for new users: terms and conditions, your profile, an optional password change, a hand-drawn tour of the screen and slides on how loans, recoveries and day-end work.
A getting-started checklist at the bottom of the dashboard that tracks your first steps.
Hindi language support: choose your language in Settings. The Settings and Change Password screens are translated so far.
Help now has Replay Tour, How It Works and Getting Started, so you can bring any guide back at any time.
Administrators choose in Settings, Welcome Tour, whether the tour shows on the first login or on every login, and can see who has accepted the terms.
improved: The tour follows your role: you only see the menus and slides you can use.
Keyboard navigation for the tour, and a Calm mode in Settings that turns off the motion.
